The Road Code · Daily Lesson

Lock In And Focus.

November 13, 2026 · Midway, Georgia · Day 1,291 · 66,695.3 documented miles — this tour.

Lock In And Focus — the film, 2:46

Day 1,291 was the day he called himself: an active recovery day. Wheels up at 10:08 AM out of Richmond Hill — but not before the work. The gazebo was his gym that morning, Blocks B and C before a single mile turned. Then US-17 south toward Midway, fasted since 7 PM the night before, and his own name for the whole method: “I practice what I SPREACH.”

Eighteen-point-three miles, 388 feet of climb, about an hour of moving time — recovery on purpose, not a day off wearing a costume. The first bite of the day waited until 1:39 PM, after the miles: eighteen hours and thirty-nine minutes fasted. Covered up and layered in the cold at the start; naked by noon. Midway Motel by early afternoon — booked the way he always books it, on arrival.

Lock In And Focus — the sizzle cut, 1:00

And the day closed the way it started — on his word, verbatim: “There ain’t no midway, there ain’t no finish line. No sir.” Day 2 of the 50-day Proving Season: 49 days to January 1, and the standard travels.

The lesson — THE DISCIPLINE: There are no days off — only days you spend on purpose. Recovery isn’t a skipped day; it’s a chosen one. The workout still happened, the miles still turned, the fast still held — the standard never moved.

R.O.D.A. — Rest Ordered, Discipline Applied.

⚔️ Coach R.O.D.A. // The Road Code · Lock In And Focus.
